head.b:skin: :root{--paper:#fdfcf9;--ink:#292723;--taupe:#e5ded4;--muted:#77716b;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'DM Sans','Noto Sans KR',sans-serif}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);margin:0;font-family:var(--sans);line-height:1.75}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img{max-width:100%;height:auto}.announcement{padding:10px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:white;background:#352e29}.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:84px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd7ce;padding:15px 6%}.brand{font:400 30px var(--serif);letter-spacing:.16em}.brand small{display:block;font:500 8px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.28em}.menu{display:flex;gap:25px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em}.intro{text-align:center;padding:110px 20px;background:#efe9e2}.intro h1{font:400 clamp(48px,6vw,86px) var(--serif);margin:10px 0}.intro p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.content{max-width:1310px;margin:80px auto;padding:0 6%}.blog-posts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:55px 34px}.post-outer{min-width:0}.post-title,.post-title a{font:400 36px/1.3 var(--serif)}.post-body{line-height:2;font-size:15px;color:#555}.post-body img{width:100%;max-height:600px;object-fit:cover}.date-header{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}.post-footer{font-size:12px;color:#82796f}.separator{clear:both}.blog-pager{padding:40px 0;text-align:center}.footer{background:#332d29;color:#f3efe9;padding:60px 6%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}.footer a{color:#d4c9bd}.widget-title{display:none}.blog-feeds{display:none}@media(max-width:700px){.bar{flex-direction:column;padding:20px}.menu{gap:12px;font-size:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}.blog-posts{grid-template-columns:1fr}.content{margin:55px auto}.intro{padding:75px 20px}.post-title,.post-title a{font-size:29px}.footer{flex-direction:column}}
